justification: Both show a single large low-relief profile figure facing left with elaborate headgear, a mass of tightly regimented rows of curls (beard/feathering), fringed and tasselled robes, and long overlapping wing/fan feathers behind, rendered with identical conventions of incised repeating detail and flat outlined relief. The chief differences are that A is a cropped bust of a human head while B shows a full-length raptor-headed winged figure with a raised arm holding an object beside a stylised plant with rosette blossoms, a scene element absent from A.
